name: s81svc_irg_hsfp-irghsfp-COMMIT
purpose: DIE-S81-85 svc provider form A: IRG fastpad hslice (ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice_fp) pilot kit at fill 0.532 (COORD 11-09 (a)), 32 per svc_lo type

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice_fp u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice_fp.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: irg_fastpad_chunk_exact
bench.cmd: cd results/rtl/svc_irg_fastpad_1109/bench && ln -sfn ../../../.. src && bash run.sh good 11 40000 0 8

bench.name: irg_fastpad_chunk_mutant_m1
bench.cmd: cd results/rtl/svc_irg_fastpad_1109/bench && ln -sfn ../../../.. src && bash run.sh mut_m1 11 40000 0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.0 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81svc_irg_hsfp/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81svc_irg_hsfp/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81svc_irg_hsfp --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice_fp  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
